all_quotes.quote: We present high-resolution (1.0$''$) Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA) observations of CO (1–0) and CO (2–1) rotational transitions toward the nearby IR-luminous merger NGC 1614
NGC 1614 is a nearby LIRG (cite: Armus09) at a distance of 67.8 Mpc (1$''$ = 330 pc).

we present high-resolution, high-sensitivity, and $uv$-matched ALMA observations of the nearby IR-bright galaxy NGC 1614 in order to understand the distribution and kinematics of multiple CO lines and their excitation conditions in the nuclear region.
